sources.title: DeepSeek (AI) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: DeepSeek (AI) ... DeepSeek[a] is a series of large language models developed by the Chinese company DeepSeek. The series began in November 2023. A model released on 20 January 2025, DeepSeek-R1, became a breakthrough success, surpassing ChatGPT as the most downloaded freeware app on the iOS App Store in the United States by 27 January.

sources.title: Majestic Labs Prometheus: 128TB AI Server [2026]
sources.snippet: Majestic Labs unveiled Prometheus on April 28, 2026 with 128TB memory, 1,000x a Blackwell GPU, $100M raise, and a memory-first AI server bet.
